purpose: Template for any premise or relation proposed after solver-premise-map-v1. REWORDING_ONLY proposals do not receive new premise IDs.

candidate.semanticNoveltyClass: NEW_PARENT | SPECIALIZATION | SCOPE_SPLIT | EVIDENCE_STATE_CHANGE | IMPLEMENTATION_FORM | RELATION_ONLY | REWORDING_ONLY

admissionRules: REWORDING_ONLY does not receive a new premise ID.
IMPLEMENTATION_FORM must name a semantic parent.
A closure-like evidence state must state scope/population, evidence basis, and architecture epoch or explicit epoch-independence rationale.
Diagnostic correlation does not grant prune authority.
A mechanism is not production capability until its maturity stage and deployment boundary are explicit.
A new premise should populate a thin region, split a conflated abstraction, add a materially new relation, or expose a cross-cutting mismatch; vocabulary novelty is insufficient.
Mining-derived candidates remain proposals until admitted into a post-v1 map version.
